Three files in the repository contain the literal string `GracePeriodTime`, all under the OrderProcessor project:

1. **`src/OrderProcessor/BackgroundTaskOptions.cs:5`** — declares the option property: `public int GracePeriodTime { get; set; }`
2. **`src/OrderProcessor/appsettings.json:15`** — configures the value: `"GracePeriodTime": "1",`
3. **`src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:72` and `:74`** — two occurrences: the SQL parameter reference `>= @GracePeriodTime` in the query filtering submitted orders, and `command.Parameters.AddWithValue("GracePeriodTime", TimeSpan.FromMinutes(_options.GracePeriodTime))` (this line contains the string twice — as the parameter name and as the options property read).

I established the list with a case-sensitive content search across the whole repository, then cross-checked with both `git grep` (tracked files) and a recursive `grep -rIl` (which also covers untracked/ignored files); both returned the same three files, so there are no additional matches hidden by ignore rules.
